views.markdown: **HaptiX** delivers system-wide haptic feedback on iOS 13–17, supporting both rootless (Dopamine 2 / palera1n) and rootful jailbreaks. Built on `UIImpactFeedbackGenerator` for clean, hardware-accelerated feedback with zero double-fire.

- 5 Taptic Engine profiles: Light, Medium, Heavy, Soft, Rigid
- 50ms cooldown gate prevents double-fire
- SpringBoard hooks: Volume, Power, Lock/Unlock, Home Screen Icons, App Switcher
- UIKit hooks: Keyboard, Buttons, Switches, Table Cells, Scroll edges
- Per-app exclusion list via AltList
- Hot-reload — no respring required when changing settings

- Expanded support to iOS 13.0 – 17.0
- Added rootful jailbreak support alongside existing rootless support
- Preferences path resolved dynamically at runtime (no recompile needed)
- CI now produces separate rootless and rootful `.deb` packages

- Initial public release
- Replaced `AudioServicesPlaySystemSound` with `UIImpactFeedbackGenerator`
- Fixed cooldown: 80ms → 50ms
- Added 5 configurable haptic profiles
- Corrected AltList blacklist integration
